title: OPS — Telegram operator UX wave 26: posting-health, export-files count, token-health signals in /health
description: Add 3 new /health signals: (1) posting-health.json gate summary (all_pass + gate progress string), (2) export-files.txt video count (how many exported videos ready to post), (3) token-health.json TikTok token status reading from JSON (expiry, status field). These complete wave 26 of the operator UX sprint series (10 signals total when combined with 7 already uncommitted). All signals are added to cmdHealth() in cmd-system.ts.
